description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Vaan], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Wind Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Wind Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Dualcast, Instant Cast Wind (Tactical)] to user if Level 2+ EnWind, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Wind Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Wind attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Wind Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)
Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dualcast, Instant Cast Wind (Tactical)
description.text: Wind abilities trigger an additional time; Cast speed x999999 for Wind abilities

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Vaan
description.text: Wind abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
